summary: REGENXBIO Inc. filed an 8-K reporting FDA clinical hold on RGX-121 gene therapy for Hunter Syndrome after asymptomatic spine MRI findings in five participants. The company does not expect near-term BLA resubmission, marking a regulatory setback, not a corporate transaction. No deal terms, no stakeholder actions, no strategic alternatives or capital event. The filing is an operational/regulatory development with no special-situation classification applicable.
